description: This source file defines a RouteBuilder class used for constructing API route configurations in a RESTful web service, including methods for setting route properties, handling documentation, and building route objects.

classes.name: RouteBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for constructing API route configurations with properties like path, method, parameters, responses, and documentation.

classes.name: ResponseError
classes.description: Represents an API response, including status code, message, model, headers, and default flag.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: Describes a response header with optional schema and description.

classes.name: Items
classes.description: Schema description for simple header types.

methods.name: Do
methods.description: Executes provided configuration functions on the RouteBuilder, supporting fluent style.

methods.name: To
methods.description: Binds a route to a specific handler function.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Sets the HTTP method for the route.

methods.name: Produces
methods.description: Specifies MIME types the route can produce.

methods.name: Consumes
methods.description: Specifies MIME types the route can consume.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Sets the relative URL path for the route.

methods.name: Doc
methods.description: Adds documentation string for the route.

methods.name: Notes
methods.description: Adds detailed notes about route behavior.

methods.name: Reads
methods.description: Defines the expected request payload type.

methods.name: ParameterNamed
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter by name for modification.

methods.name: Writes
methods.description: Defines the response payload types.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the route documentation.

methods.name: Operation
methods.description: Sets the operation name for documentation.

methods.name: Returns
methods.description: Documents expected response codes and models.

methods.name: ReturnsWithHeaders
methods.description: Documents responses with headers.

methods.name: DefaultReturns
methods.description: Sets default response message and model.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Adds metadata key-value pairs.

methods.name: AddExtension
methods.description: Adds custom extension data.

methods.name: Deprecate
methods.description: Marks route as deprecated.

methods.name: AllowedMethodsWithoutContentType
methods.description: Overrides default methods that do not require Content-Type header.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Adds a filter function to the route.

methods.name: If
methods.description: Adds a condition function to control route matching.

methods.name: ContentEncodingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables response content encoding.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs the final Route object from the builder configuration.

methods.name: servicePath
methods.description: Sets the root service path.

methods.name: typeNameHandler
methods.description: Sets the function for converting types to string names.

methods.name: copyDefaults
methods.description: Copies default produces and consumes if not set.
